top_signals.title: Ukraine disputes Elon Musk’s claim that its military violated Starlink terms during drone operations
top_signals.summary: Ukraine challenged Musk’s claim that its military violated Starlink terms, arguing that commercial Starlink limits prevented medium- and long-range strike use.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Slow AI Buildout Could Be Inflationary: Natixis' Herrero
top_signals.summary: Alicia Garcia Herrero, chief APAC economist at Natixis, tells Bloomberg TV that rapid AI adoption could be inflationary if data-center construction falls short of what is needed to meet demand for compute. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: Brazil's Lula reelected president in runoff vote
Machado returns to Venezuela to urge democratic transition
top_signals.summary: Opposition leader Maria Corina Machado's return risks complicating the administration of U.S. President Donald Trump's strategy for Venezuela.
